methodology.selection_basis: Combine locked Stage 1 L10 evidence, Stage 2 Floor/Core/Ceiling structure, Stage 3 context, 25P distribution evidence and current sportsbook quotes. Historical HR is descriptive, not a predicted probability.
methodology.threshold_policy: Prefer a conservative Floor/Core when multiple evidence streams support it. Price alone or historical HR alone is insufficient.
methodology.nonselection_policy: For non-selected records, Floor is the evaluated reference threshold; Puka receptions is not separately selected to avoid duplicating exposure to the same player already selected for receiving yards.
